title: Techcombank Hanoi International Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
meta_description: Techcombank Hanoi International Marathon review: 13,000+ runners on 5 October 2025, a heritage route, and winning times from 2:28 to 1:10. What to expect in 2026.
dek: The fourth Techcombank Hanoi International Marathon put more than 13,000 runners on a route through the capital's landmarks in October 2025. Here is what that edition was like, ahead of the fifth.
verdict: The Techcombank Hanoi International Marathon has grown quickly: its fourth edition, on 5 October 2025, drew more than 13,000 runners, nearly one and a half times the previous season's field [1][2]. The route passes Hanoi's historical and cultural landmarks [1][2]. At the front, Ethiopia's Kure Ebisa Takele won the men's marathon in 2:28:34 and former SEA Games bronze medallist Hoang Thi Ngoc Hoa the women's in 2:54:19, while national champions Nguyen Trung Cuong and Nguyen Thi Oanh won the half [2]. If you want a large, strongly contested city marathon in Hanoi in early October, this is it. Remember that the VPBank Hanoi International Marathon follows a few weeks later.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: The fourth edition was run on Sunday 5 October 2025, organised by Sunrise Events Vietnam with Techcombank as strategic sponsor, under the direction of the Hanoi People's Committee [1][2]. More than 13,000 domestic and international runners took part [1][2], nearly one and a half times the number at the previous season [1].
The routes passed many of the capital's historical and cultural landmarks [1][2]. A Marathon Village expo opened at Vinhomes Riverside Long Bien before race day [1].

sections.heading: The Front of the Race
paragraphs: Ethiopia's Kure Ebisa Takele won the men's marathon in 2:28:34, ahead of Kenya's Lilan Kennedy (2:30:27), with Vietnamese record holder Hoang Nguyen Thanh third [2]. Hoang Thi Ngoc Hoa led the women's marathon from the opening few hundred metres and won in 2:54:19, ahead of Bui Thi Thu Ha and Doan Thi Oanh [2].
SEA Games champion Nguyen Trung Cuong won the men's half marathon in 1:10:07, more than three minutes clear, and Nguyen Thi Oanh won the women's in 1:20:05 [2].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a big early-autumn marathon in Hanoi with a fast front of the field and a heritage route. The fifth edition follows a year in which the field grew by about half.
Hanoi now has two big October marathons, this one and VPBank's. Check the dates and routes of both before you choose, and book accommodation early.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2025 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Techcombank Hanoi International Marathon in 2025?
faqs.answer: More than 13,000 domestic and international runners took part in the fourth edition on 5 October 2025, nearly one and a half times the previous season's field. The race covers the marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km.

faqs.question: Who won the Techcombank Hanoi International Marathon in 2025?
faqs.answer: Ethiopia's Kure Ebisa Takele won the men's marathon in 2:28:34 and Hoang Thi Ngoc Hoa the women's in 2:54:19. SEA Games champion Nguyen Trung Cuong won the men's half marathon in 1:10:07 and Nguyen Thi Oanh the women's in 1:20:05.

faqs.question: Is this the same race as the VPBank Hanoi International Marathon?
faqs.answer: No. The Techcombank Hanoi International Marathon, organised by Sunrise Events Vietnam, is held in early October. The VPBank Hanoi International Marathon is a separate race held later in October on its own route.
